propositions: SKILL.md lacks a Step 0 before Phase 1 that searches the tracker for existing reports and establishes the reported-against version.
The tracker search must cover all statuses including closed tickets (759 of 764 bug tickets are closed) and is not a gate; the decision to link duplicates or resume is determined by match status.

The reported-against version floor has no rebar-version ticket field; it must be derived from report text or converted from ticket created_at nanoseconds via git rev-list --before="@$(( <created_at> / 1000000000 ))" origin/main.
Piping raw nanosecond created_at directly into git --before= silently returns the tip; the divisor and @<unix-seconds> form must be explicit in the runnable command.
Step 0 must verify worktree currency (git rev-parse HEAD equals origin/main) and record whether reported-against version is unknown.
The Step-0 duplicates link is an own-tracker writeback and must be added to the approval-gate carve-out pre-approved list to avoid mandating user approval for an internal action.
